text:
WOW WOW WOW!!! LOOK AT HIM GO!!!

He’s FLYING in the air!! Like a birdie! But with a skateboard!! And his hair is all spiky and blonde like sunshine!! He’s wearing stripes and jeans and he looks SO COOL doing that trick!!!

The board is flipping under him — whoa!! — and he’s gonna land it, I know it!! Everyone’s watching!! Look at their faces!! They’re like “OH MY GOSH!” just like me!!!

And there’s trees behind him and concrete ramps and red spray paint — so many colors!! This is the BEST DAY EVER!! Can I have a skateboard?? Please please pleeease?? I wanna fly too!! 🛹✨💥
